title: Travel: Paul McCartney – New York to New Orleans | 1975
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney flew from New York to New Orleans on 16 January 1975.

Wings had started recording the Venus And Mars album in London, but chose to relocate to Allen Toussaint’s Sea-Saint Recording Studio to tape the bulk of the material. They remained in New Orleans until the end of February 1975.

Page last updated: 30 December 2025
